changes.comment: Slim Team, TeamMate and workflow MCP receipts and lists while retaining diagnostic details. Tool owners write actionable facts and reminders directly into complete success text; the adapter forwards it without a JSON copy or structuredContent. Absent or empty text retains structured results. Add optional agents description, tags and developerInstructions with onboarding preservation and launch/resume application. Replace provider capability snapshots with configured runtime metadata. Add TeamMate record timestamps and bound TeamLeader status. Text-capable Channel tools must omit outputSchema; otherwise SDK validation can fail after execution. Existing configuration and state remain readable.
